summary: Attempt 1 used two servers racing two carts for the single SOLO unit. In 11 of 20 runs both carts completed, producing two orders for one unit, which failed no_oversell and reserved_matches_reservations. The reservation step guards stock with Modules.LOCKING, which defaults to the in-memory provider, and that lock is only held inside one process. Cross-server races therefore slip through. The finding is confirmed by the runs. I did not explore further causes (stale counters, duplicate completion, payment-order link, stock location) within the budget.
